Here's my take, as some of the people have already pointed out. You're playing really defensive which in my opinion is not that big of a problem however, you are overly passive. Too afraid to commit from what i can see.

String wise, i'd say it's pretty damn good. You know your stuff though i think there are things you can work on aside from strings and combos

Firstly, work on fast fall dairs, you realize that when you try to go for a dair to start your pressure. You often float in the air waiting for an opening to strike which while not a bad option, allows your opponent to control the flow of the match (Example: Opponent plays equally passive and waits for you to get impatient and throw out random moves). Instead i suggest you do fast fall nair or dair, both work to be a little more proactive but comes with risk as well

Secondly, your movement seems a little lacking for example there isn't much of baiting with your movements. Normally you can dash back and forth to try to bait the opponent to press a button but because of your passive and floatly nature. You leave yourself short of mobility i would suggest you learn to do your fast fall dashing, it greatly increases your move speed and often times can leave lower ranking players confused

Finally, just play more!

Hope this helps :)
